about.title: JetSim is the freedom to travel without borders. One click - and the whole world is in your pocket
about.text: JetSim - your fast ticket to the world of unlimited connectivity
about.bigtext: JetSim is your fast ticket to the world of unlimited connectivity. We created the company in 2020 to completely change the perception of roaming and make international connection easy, profitable and accessible to everyone. Forget about crazy roaming bills and searching for a local SIM at the airport - with JetSim everything is solved in a couple of minutes. Connect eSIM directly from your smartphone, choose a tariff for your trip and be online anywhere in the world

about.benefit5: 🚀 Connection in 2 minutes - just scan the QR code and you're online
about.benefit6: 💰 Pay only for what you actually use
about.benefit8: 🛫 We are built into the travel industry: tour operators, hotels, airlines - the whole ecosystem is already with us

card.heading: Our advantages
card.card1-t: Activation in 2 minutes via QR code. No office visits and waiting - connection is available immediately
card.card2-t: Personal, work and tourist tariff - all in one smartphone. Easy to switch in a couple of clicks
card.card3-t: Don't waste your nerves communicating with various bots or AI. Trust the professionals, our team will solve any connection problems instantly!
card.card4-t: eSIM cannot be lost or damaged. If you lose your phone, the number is easy to transfer to another device
card.card5-t: Large traffic packages at an affordable cost. No hidden payments, overpayments and imposed services
card.card6-t: No plastic SIM cards - less waste and environmental care
